verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party scripting or plugin API (Lua, Python, kittens or similar) for extending the terminal itself. The closest items do not qualify: MCP servers extend the AI agent rather than the terminal, the settings file is configuration rather than scripting, Warp Drive workflows are saved commands, Fig completion specs are a bundled feature, and the AGPL source is a developer building block.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the terminal with scripts or plugins in a real language (Lua, Python, kittens) beyond built-in options
